summary: Finds a named range by its name.
description: A named range is the stable way to point at a block of cells that a person may move around the sheet. Apps Script only offers the whole list, so the names are walked and compared.
A name that is not defined gives `null`, which is the case to handle when a template has been edited by hand.
returns: the named range, or `null` when no such name is defined.
